card.name: Verbs and possessives after 'to'/'their'
card.fires_on: Words right after a linking word in general web prose, usually a verb after 'to' (optimize, work, understand) or a possessive/noun that continues a clause (their, hypothesis, power). Mostly science, method and performance writing, not drug labels.

modes.label: Possessive or noun in a clause
modes.description: 'their' or a noun such as hypothesis or power that continues a clause about a person's or system's own thing.
modes.example: against<< their>> own reason. He thus decided to write
